verdict.line: You lose if you facetank Malphite's Q-W-E chain once it's fully ranked around level 4-6 or eat a clean Unstoppable Force; you win if you wall off with Hallowed Mist and keep snipping Q so his Granite Shield never finishes recharging.

brief.thesis: Every tool Malphite has — Seismic Shard at 625 range, Brutal Strikes and Ground Slam at 400 — still requires him to walk into melee range to do anything, and Gwen's W (Hallowed Mist) means he can only target her if he physically enters the mist. That structural mismatch, not raw damage, is why Gwen holds a 52.8% head-to-head over 1,406 games: she can refuse the engage almost indefinitely while her Q keeps chipping his Granite Shield before it ever tops off.

theirWindow.what: This is Malphite's only real kill window: Ground Slam into Brutal Strikes into Seismic Shard back-to-back. Hold W in reserve rather than standing in a straight trade here, and don't let him land Seismic Shard first since it steals your movement speed and sets up the chain.

yourWindow.when: Granite Shield down, his cooldowns spent
yourWindow.what: The instant he's used Q or E to poke and his shield hasn't recharged, dash in with E (Skip 'n Slash, 400 range) and chain Q snips. You out-cycle him here since Q drops to 4.25s cooldown by level 7 and 3.5s by level 9, far faster than his 7-8s Q/E.

start.why: Highest win rate and pick rate start (53.6% over 1,415 games); the mana and ability haste fuel the Q-snip cycles you need to keep Granite Shield from recharging.

boots.why: 52.8% win rate over 682 games; magic penetration matters here since Malphite's Brutal Strikes temporarily spikes his armor, and you need your passive damage to still bite through it.

core.why: First item on the 60.7%-win-rate path over 275 games, sets up the ability haste for faster Q cycles.
Bonus damage to already-low-health targets synergizes with A Thousand Cuts chipping his Granite Shield down.
Caps the highest-win-rate build path; raw AP scaling turns your passive and Q true damage into real burst.

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the extended Q-poke trades this lane is built around and gives sustain back exactly when you're chipping his shield down over multiple exchanges.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is both the highest win rate (52.1%) and highest pick rate (52.3%) combo; Ignite converts your passive's percent-health damage into secured early kills in a lane you're already favored in.

playing.title: Wall off the instant he commits
playing.detail: The moment Malphite steps up to use any ability, pop W (Hallowed Mist). He can only target you once he enters it, so he either wastes the engage or walks into your mist and eats free Q snips.

playing.title: Spam Q, never let it sit
playing.detail: Max Q first and fire it on cooldown (6.5s at rank 1, down to 3.5s at rank 5). The goal is to keep landing snips often enough that Granite Shield never gets the uninterrupted window it needs to recharge.

playing.title: Only dash E to confirm
playing.detail: Use E (Skip 'n Slash, 400 range) to close for a guaranteed Q follow-up or to escape after poking, and prioritize landing a hit during its attack-speed window for the partial cooldown refund.

playing.title: Hold W through level 4-6
playing.detail: Once he has Q, W, and E all ranked, he can chain Ground Slam into Brutal Strikes into Seismic Shard for real damage. Don't burn W early in that window — save it for when he actually commits.

playing.title: Punish immediately after his poke
playing.detail: Any time he throws Seismic Shard or Ground Slam and whiffs or trades, his shield is down and his cooldowns (8s Q, 7s E) are gone. That's your cue to dash in and dump Q stacks before he resets.

playing.title: Respect the level 6 ultimate
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force is a 1000-range charge that knocks you up on hit. Once he's 6, don't stand in open lane without minions or terrain breaking his line, and keep W ready to blunt whatever follows the knockup.

playing.title: Don't force kills, scale instead
playing.detail: This is only a 52.8% lane over 1,406 games, not a stomp. Play the shield-denial game patiently and let your Shadowflame/Rabadon's power spike do the winning rather than forcing all-ins solo.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, boots, runes, summoner spells, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures above are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch (16.19.1). The cooldown windows, trade timing, and tactical reasoning tying those numbers to Gwen's and Malphite's actual ability text are my own analysis, not measured data.
